title: ALMA Multiple-transition Molecular Line Observations of the Ultraluminous Infrared Galaxy IRAS 20551-4250: Different HCN, HCO<SUP>+</SUP>, and HNC Excitation, and Implications for Infrared Radiative Pumping
question: How do HCN, HCO+ and HNC excite and differ in abundance in the buried-AGN ULIRG IRAS 20551-4250, and does infrared radiative pumping affect their rotational excitation?

what.value: ALMA Cycle 0 HCN J=4-3 flux 9.5 Jy km/s and HCO+, HNC J=4-3 fluxes

evidence.quote: derived in our Cycle 0 observations (9.5$\pm$0.2 Jy km s$^{-1}$) (cite: ima13b)

what.value: J=3-2 fluxes of HCN, HCO+, HNC and v2=1f lines
Einstein A and energy levels from CDMS

evidence.quote: are from the Cologne Database of Molecular Spectroscopy (CDMS) (cite: mul05)

recipe.method: Continuum subtraction from line-free channels, clean to 20-40 km/s channels, extract spectra at continuum peak
Gaussian fits to spectra, moment 0/1/2 maps, imfit deconvolved sizes
HCN/H13CN etc. flux ratios vs 12C/13C = 50-100 give flux attenuation and tau
assumptions: Isotopologue lines optically thin; well-mixed geometry tau/(1-exp(-tau))

recipe.goal: Test IR pumping and abundance ratios
recipe.method: Compare v2=1f excitation temperature to threshold T0/ln(A_vib/A_rot); column density ratios from flux/A_ul
assumptions: J=4 level fraction same across molecules; v2=1f optically thin

recipe.method: RADEX LVG grid in n_H2, T_kin to reproduce flux ratios
key_parameters: n_H2 10^3-10^8 cm-3; T_kin 10-500 K; dv=300 km/s; N_mol=1e16 cm-2; T_bak 3 K

recipe.method: MOLPOP LVG with 5-30 micron power-law IR field at 30 and 100 pc, plane-parallel
key_parameters: n_H2=1e5, T_kin=100 K, dv=300 km/s, N=1e16; F_nu=0.0024 lambda^2.0 Jy

recipe.method: Broad Gaussian wing, blue-wing flux doubled, mass from L'CO with alpha=0.8, rate = 3 M V/R
assumptions: CO J=3-2 optically thick and thermalized; ULIRG-like alpha ~0.8

evidence.quote: adopted the re-calibrated HCN J=4–3 flux with 11.6$\pm$0.2 (Jy km s$^{-1}$)
HCN-to-H$^{13}$CN J=3–2 flux in (Jy km s$^{-1}$) to be $\sim$22$\pm$3
are $\sim$360 (K), $<$280 (K), and $\sim$360 (K) for HCN, HCO$^{+}$, and HNC
we obtain a molecular outflow rate with Ṁ$_{\rm outf}$ $\sim$ 150 (M$_{\odot}$ yr$^{-1}$)

not_stated_but_needed: clean weighting/robust, deconvolver, threshold and masks
line-free channel ranges per spectral window
RADEX collisional rate files and grid sampling
how Gaussian fits were done (fitting code)
score_reason: Public data and clear numeric tables, but imaging parameters and fitting details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public archive data, line fluxes tabulated numerically, though some processing details unstated.
